data.sub: Uttarakhand nyayik seva pariksha mein Shreya Singh ne 5vi rank paayi.
data.asar: Padhai karo toh aise ki sab congratulate karein.
data.caption:
Uttarakhand nyayik seva pariksha ka result aa gaya hai!

• Shreya Singh ne paayi 5vi rank
• Uttarakhand pariksha mein safalta
• Logon ne di badhai

Mazedaar safalta ki kahani!

Save kar lo, baad mein kaam aayega
